title: 上部 凡尘问道 第13章 功德点生存困境上部 凡尘问道 第14章 神秘人规则试探
content_zh:
第1节十二时辰生死限，功德点成救命符
凌无妄刚潜回外门居所，就被凌小妹扑进怀里，哭声带着绝望的颤抖“无妄哥！娘快撑不住了！药堂说必须用清灵丹续脉，可那要50点功德点，我们一点都没有！”
他冲到床边，只见凌母面色青灰，气息微弱到几乎察觉不到，胸口的伤口泛着黑紫，显然是巡查使的灵力余毒未清，已经侵入经脉。
“娘的经脉正在坏死，”凌无妄指尖搭上脉搏，心脏骤然紧缩，“药堂怎么说？有没有通融的办法？”
“通融？”凌小妹抹着眼泪摇头，“药堂的谢掌柜说，道院规矩大于天，没有功德点，就算等死也不给药！还说…还说娘这种‘废物’，死了也不浪费资源！”
系统面板弹出猩红提示【凌母生命体征持续下滑，经脉坏死速率加快，剩余存活时间12时辰。清灵丹为唯一解药，需50点功德点兑换。当前主角功德点0】
【道院规则补充杂役外门弟子无功德点将被断绝食物供应，超3日无功德点将被逐出道院，任由生死】
凌无妄攥紧拳头，指节发白。他刚晋升外门弟子时的10点初始功德点，早已在兑换粗粮和简易伤药时耗尽。而杂役营的低阶任务，一天最多赚1点，就算不吃不喝，也凑不够50点。
“我去任务堂！”凌无妄转身就走。
“没用的！”凌小妹拉住他，“王坤的人把所有高功德点任务都垄断了，我们只能接挖矿、挑粪的苦活，根本来不及！”
凌无妄掰开她的手，眼神坚定“就算是抢，我也要凑齐功德点！”
任务堂内人声鼎沸，却弥漫着压抑的绝望。墙壁上的任务卷轴分为三栏天级任务（100+功德点）需筑基期修为，地级任务（20-80功德点）被内门弟子垄断，人级任务（1-5功德点）全是高危苦役。
“哟，这不是我们的‘无灵根天才’吗？”顾琛摇着折扇走来，身后跟着两个凶神恶煞的随从，“怎么，来接任务换棺材本？”
“我要接地级任务‘灵草园除虫’，”凌无妄无视挑衅，直指卷轴上标注50功德点的任务，“要求炼气中期即可，我符合条件。”
顾琛嗤笑一声，抬手就撕了那卷轴“地级任务也是你能接的？道院规矩，外门弟子接地级任务，需内门长老推荐。你一个杂役出身的废物，也配？”
周围的杂役纷纷低头，敢怒不敢言。一个瘦高个杂役孟春悄悄递来一个眼神，示意他看墙角“只有那个‘噬灵虫清理’任务没人接，3点功德点，却要进瘴气弥漫的后山灵草园，已经死了三个杂役了。”
凌无妄看向那枚布满灰尘的卷轴，心中已然有了决断。12时辰，50功德点，后山灵草园是唯一的机会。
第2节瘴气弥漫生死地，规则破局除虫患
后山灵草园被瘴气笼罩，入口处的石碑刻着“擅入者死”四个血红大字。园内的灵草叶片枯黄，布满密密麻麻的咬痕，指甲盖大小的噬灵虫爬满藤蔓，空气中弥漫着腐臭的毒气。
“这些虫子以灵草灵气为食，还会释放毒素，”孟春跟在后面，捂着口鼻低声道，“之前来的杂役要么被毒死，要么被虫子咬伤，毒素侵入经脉变成废人。”

凌无妄运转规则之眼，噬灵虫的身体结构瞬间清晰头部的“灵犀腺”是感应灵气的核心，腹部的“泄毒孔”是能量循环的弱点，而它们惧怕特定频率的灵力波动。
【检测到噬灵虫规则灵犀腺接收灵气频率为03-05hz，高于1hz的高频灵力会使其神经紊乱；泄毒孔无防御，注入灵力可引爆体内毒素】
“孟春，借你的铁铲一用。”凌无妄接过工具，运转“极简引气法”，将灵力频率提升至12hz，指尖泛起淡金色光晕。
他对准一只噬灵虫的灵犀腺，铁铲轻轻一点。虫子瞬间僵住，身体抽搐着蜷缩成一团，毒素从泄毒孔溢出，很快失去生机。
“真的有用！”孟春又惊又喜，“凌兄弟，你这是什么手法？”
“高频灵力破其感知，”凌无妄快速解释，同时将灵力运转法门教给孟春，“按这个频率运转灵力，对准它们的头部红点，再捅腹部的小孔，百发百中。”
两人分工合作，凌无妄负责清理密集虫群，孟春则指导随后赶来的几个穷苦杂役。不到两个时辰，灵草园外围的噬灵虫被清理大半，枯萎的灵草开始泛出新绿。
“前面是虫巢！”孟春指着灵草园深处，那里的瘴气最浓，隐约能看到一个篮球大小的黑色虫茧，“虫后就在里面，之前没人敢靠近！”
凌无妄运转规则之眼，虫茧内的虫后体型庞大，外壳坚硬，灵犀腺被层层防护包裹，普通攻击根本无效。但他发现，虫后每隔十息就会张开泄毒孔释放一次毒素，这是唯一的破绽。
content_en:
Section 1: Twelve hours of life and death, merit points become a life-saving talisman
As soon as Ling Wuwang sneaked back to the outer residence, Ling Xiaomei threw herself into her arms. Her cry was trembling with despair, "Brother Wuwang! Mom can't hold it anymore! The medicine hall said that you must use Qingling Pill to renew your pulse, but it costs 50 merit points, and we don't have any!"
He rushed to the bedside and saw that Ling's mother's face was blue and gray, her breath was so weak that she could hardly detect it, and the wound on her chest was glowing black and purple. It was obvious that the lingering poison from the inspector's spiritual power had invaded her meridians.
"My mother's meridians are dying." Ling Wuwang felt his pulse with his fingertips, and his heart suddenly tightened. "What did the medicine hall say? Is there any way to accommodate it?"
"Accommodating?" Ling Xiaomei wiped her tears and shook her head, "Shopkeeper Xie of the medicine hall said that the Taoist temple's rules are greater than the heavens, and if there is no merit, no medicine will be given even if you wait for death! He also said... He also said that a 'waste' like my mother will not waste resources even if she dies!"
A scarlet prompt popped up on the system panel [Ling's mother's vital signs continued to decline, the rate of meridian necrosis accelerated, and the remaining survival time was 12 hours. Qingling Pill is the only antidote and requires 50 merit points to redeem. The current protagonist’s merit points are 0]
[Additional Taoist rules: Outer disciples who have no merit points and have no merit points will be cut off from food supply. If they have no merit points for more than 3 days, they will be expelled from the Taoist temple and left to live or die]
Ling Wuwang clenched his fists, his knuckles turning white. The 10 initial merit points he had when he was first promoted to an outer sect disciple had already been exhausted when he exchanged them for coarse grains and simple wound medicine. As for the low-level tasks in the handyman camp, you can earn up to 1 point a day. Even if you don't eat or drink, you can't make up 50 points.
"I'm going to the mission hall!" Ling Wuwang turned around and left.
"It's useless!" Ling Xiaomei grabbed him, "Wang Kun's people have monopolized all the high-merit tasks. We can only take over the hard work of mining and picking dung, and there is no time at all!"
Ling Wuwang opened her hand, his eyes firm, "Even if it's a robbery, I will get the merit points!"
The mission hall was bustling with people, but filled with suppressed despair. The mission scroll on the wall is divided into three columns. Heaven-level missions (100+ merit points) require foundation-building cultivation, earth-level missions (20-80 merit points) are monopolized by inner disciples, and human-level missions (1-5 merit points) are all high-risk hard labor.
"Hey, isn't this our 'Genius without Spiritual Roots'?" Gu Chen walked over, waving his folding fan, followed by two menacing followers, "Why, are you here to take on a mission to exchange for a coffin book?"
"I want to take on the ground-level task of 'Spiritual Grass Garden Pest Control'," Ling Wuwang ignored the provocation and pointed directly at the task marked with 50 merit points on the scroll. "It only requires mid-stage Qi refining. I meet the conditions."
Gu Chen sneered, raised his hand and tore up the scroll, "Can you take on earth-level tasks? Taoist rules require that outer disciples receive earth-level tasks with the recommendation of the inner sect elders. Are you worthy of a waste like a handyman?"
The servants around them all lowered their heads and dared not speak out in anger. Meng Chun, a tall and thin handyman, quietly gave him a look and motioned him to look at the corner, "Only the task of 'cleaning up soul-eating insects' was left unaccepted. With 3 merit points, I had to enter the miasma-filled Lingcao Garden in the back mountain. Three handymen have already died."
Ling Wuwu looked at the dusty scroll and already had a decision in his heart. At 12 o'clock, 50 merit points, the Lingcao Garden in the back mountain is the only chance.
Section 2: Miasma permeates the land of life and death, and rules are broken to eliminate pests
The Lingcao Garden in the back mountain was shrouded in miasma. The stone tablet at the entrance was engraved with four large blood-red characters: "Those who trespass will die." The leaves of the spiritual grass in the garden were withered and yellow, covered with dense bite marks, soul-eating insects the size of fingernails crawled all over the vines, and the air was filled with putrid poisonous gas.
"These bugs feed on the spiritual energy of the spiritual grass and release toxins," Meng Chun followed, covering his mouth and nose and whispered, "The handymen who came before were either poisoned to death or bitten by bugs. The toxins invaded the meridians and turned into cripples."
Ling Wuwang operates the eye of rules, and the body structure of the soul-eating insect is instantly clear. The "spiritual gland" on the head is the core of sensing spiritual energy, and the "poison vent" on the abdomen is the energy.The weakness of the cycle, and they are afraid of spiritual energy fluctuations of a specific frequency.
[It is detected that the soul-eating insect rules that the spiritual energy received by the consonant glands is at a frequency of 03-05hz. High-frequency spiritual energy higher than 1hz will cause neurological disorders; the poison vents are defenseless, and injecting spiritual energy can detonate toxins in the body]
"Meng Chun, let me borrow your shovel." Ling Wuwang took the tool and ran the "Minimalist Qi Entrainment Method" to increase the spiritual frequency to 12hz, and a light golden halo appeared on his fingertips.
He aimed at the consonant gland of a soul-eating insect and tapped lightly with the shovel. The insect froze instantly, its body twitched and curled up into a ball, the poison overflowed from the poison vent, and it quickly lost its vitality.
"It really works!" Meng Chun was surprised and happy, "Brother Ling, what is your method?"
"High-frequency spiritual power destroys their perception," Ling Wuwang explained quickly, and taught Meng Chun the method of spiritual power operation. "Run the spiritual power at this frequency, aim it at the red dot on their head, and then poke the small hole in their abdomen. You will hit the target with perfect accuracy."
The two divided the work and cooperated. Ling Wuwu was responsible for cleaning up the dense insect swarm, while Meng Chun guided the few poor handymen who came later. In less than two hours, most of the soul-eating insects outside the spiritual grass garden were cleared away, and the withered spiritual grass began to glow with new green.
"There is an insect nest ahead!" Meng Chun pointed to the depths of the Lingcao Garden, where the miasma was the thickest, and a black insect cocoon the size of a basketball could be vaguely seen. "The insect queen is inside, and no one dared to approach it before!"
Ling Wuwang operates the Eye of Rules. The queen in the cocoon is huge, has a hard shell, and its spiritual glands are wrapped in layers of protection. Normal attacks are completely ineffective. But he discovered that the Queen of Insects would open its poison holes to release toxins every ten breaths. This was the only flaw.
